compiled:
📰 General

Anthony Edwards Suffers Bone Bruise, Expected to Miss Several Weeks in Playoffs •

Minnesota Timberwolves guard Anthony Edwards sustained a bone bruise to his left knee during Game 4 of their playoff series against the Los Angeles Lakers. Initial assessments revealed the injury did not involve any structural damage to the knee. Team doctors now estimate Edwards will be sidelined for several weeks due to the nature of the injury. The Timberwolves are currently leading the series 2-1, and Edwards’ absence presents a significant challenge.

🌍 World

Newly Emerged Footage Suggests Soviet Su-7 Jet Delivered Nuclear Payload •

A recently discovered video appears to depict a Soviet Su-7 fighter jet releasing a nuclear weapon. The footage, originating from an unidentified source, shows a jet aircraft dropping a device resembling a nuclear bomb over a sparsely populated area. Experts are currently analyzing the video to determine its authenticity and the specific weapon involved. The release of this footage has reignited interest in Cold War-era military technology and strategic doctrines.

🦅 US

Chicago Police Officer Killed, Another Critically Injured in Hospital Shooting •

A Chicago police officer, identified as John Bartholomew, was killed during a shooting at Endeavor Health Swedish Hospital on Saturday morning. The incident occurred around 11:00 a.m. and involved an exchange of gunfire with a suspect. Another officer sustained critical injuries and is currently receiving treatment. Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the shooting and have not yet released details about the suspect.

💰 Business

Tesla Introduces New System to Prevent Supercharger Queue Disputes •

Tesla has announced a new system designed to resolve conflicts and prevent disputes over charging access at its Supercharger locations. The system utilizes a digital queueing system that automatically assigns charging slots based on arrival time and vehicle type. This follows a recent incident at a Supercharger where a physical altercation occurred due to confusion over charging order. The new system aims to streamline the charging process and eliminate potential conflicts arising from congested charging stations. Tesla is rolling out the feature to its Supercharger network over the coming weeks.

💻 Technology

Leaked Details Reveal New 2D Legend of Zelda Game Coming to Switch 2 •

A new 2D Legend of Zelda game is reportedly set for release on the Nintendo Switch 2, following a leak that preceded its anticipated reveal. The game is expected to cater to fans nostalgic for earlier Zelda titles. Details surrounding the game’s release date and specific features remain unconfirmed at this time. Nintendo has not yet officially announced the game, but the leak suggests a significant focus on classic 2D Zelda gameplay.

🎭 Entertainment

Star Trek: Strange New Worlds Season 4 Premiere Date & Cast Photos Revealed •

Paramount+ has announced the premiere date for Star Trek: Strange New Worlds Season 4, set for July 23rd. The streaming service released a new teaser trailer during CCXP Mexico, offering viewers a first look at the upcoming season. Season 4 will consist of 10 episodes, which will be released weekly on Paramount+. The cast photos were also unveiled alongside the premiere date announcement.

🏅 Sports

Spurs Aim to Level Series Against Trail Blazers in Game 4 Showdown •

The San Antonio Spurs face the Portland Trail Blazers in Game 4 of their NBA playoff series today at the Moda Center. Tip-off is scheduled for 3:30 p.m. ET and will be broadcast nationally on ESPN. Currently, the Trail Blazers hold a slight advantage in the series, having won the first two games. The Spurs are seeking to tie the series with a victory in this crucial matchup.

🔬 Science

Scientists Finally Identify the ‘Golden Orb’ Discovered in Alaskan Waters •

Researchers have identified a large, metallic object discovered in the Gulf of Alaska in 2023 as a discarded Soviet-era satellite. The object, approximately 16 feet in diameter, was found at a depth of over two miles and is composed primarily of aluminum. NOAA scientists utilized advanced sonar technology to confirm the object’s origin and composition, revealing it was launched during the Cold War. The discovery provides further insight into the remnants of past space exploration activities in the region.

🩺 Health

Senior Golden Retriever Escapes Vet Waiting Room, Takes Herself for a Walk •

A senior Golden Retriever named Tequila amused her owners after wandering out of the veterinary waiting room while awaiting an appointment. The dog, known for her gentle demeanor, reportedly took herself for a walk around the clinic’s exterior. Owners captured the incident on social media, documenting Tequila’s independent exploration. The veterinarian confirmed the dog was safe and unharmed following her brief adventure.
